json_contract: strict UTF-8 JSON; duplicate keys, NaN, Infinity, -Infinity, trailing data, malformed bytes rejected
meaningful_delivery_value_contract: one shared safe syntax and closed generic/status/test vocabulary for Decision, Manifest and verification receipt identities/text; identity first token cannot be a generic/status/test value
decision_answer_contract: each required group is exactly {selected: non-placeholder customer answer}
delivery_qa_status_join: decision COMPLETE requires status.delivery_method_qa=DELIVERY_METHOD_CONFIRMED for the exact current candidate
protected_asset_match: case-insensitive path-segment and packaged-basename match across slash styles; repeatedly peel the one finite archive/package/library suffix table longest-first to a fixed point, checking every layer against canonical basename plus semantic-version/build suffix grammar
delivery_metadata_contract: meaningful non-generic IDs, existing three-part version format, and exact valid UTC confirmation timestamp

package_hashes_contract.shape: non-empty closed asset-path to sha256:<64 lowercase hex> object verified against actual bytes
package_hashes_contract.path_boundary: canonical NFC Windows-casefold-unique safe relative regular-file path; no hidden metadata component, .lccoding, .git, protected basename, ADS, drive, UNC, dot segment, control, bidi, reserved component, trailing dot/space, escape, symlink, physical-file alias or st_nlink greater than one

verification_receipt_contract: Receipt ID | Candidate ID / sha256:<64 lowercase hex> | package path | package sha256:<64 lowercase hex>; exact one-to-one package coverage
